Risk_Statement: An agent may enter personal or sensitive customer data into a prompt without approved handling rules
Existing_Control_Evidence: No evidenced data classification or input guardrails
Proposed_Controls: Data classification; prompt warning; sensitive-data detection; approved handling standard
Remediation: Define allowed data classes and block or route disallowed inputs before pilot

Risk_Statement: A plausible but incorrect response could be approved and sent to a customer
Existing_Control_Evidence: Human review is assumed but review criteria are not evidenced
Proposed_Controls: Grounded retrieval; citations to source article; confidence threshold; review checklist
Remediation: Build evaluation set and require source-linked drafts plus human approval

Risk_Statement: Malicious or compromised knowledge-base content could alter system instructions or mislead the agent
Existing_Control_Evidence: No evidenced retrieval isolation or content-review process
Proposed_Controls: Instruction hierarchy; retrieval sanitization; content approval workflow; adversarial tests
Remediation: Define retrieval trust boundary and test injection scenarios before pilot

Risk_Statement: The assistant could retrieve articles beyond an agent's authorized role
Proposed_Controls: Identity-aware retrieval; least privilege; access logging; periodic access review
Remediation: Implement and test role-based retrieval filtering

Risk_Statement: An outdated article could cause the assistant to draft incorrect policy guidance
Existing_Control_Evidence: No evidenced article owner revision cycle or freshness signal
Proposed_Controls: Content ownership; review dates; freshness metadata; escalation for stale content
Remediation: Assign article owners and remove or flag expired sources

Risk_Statement: Draft language or routing could treat customer groups inconsistently
Existing_Control_Evidence: No evidenced fairness test cases or review cadence
Proposed_Controls: Diverse test set; rubric-based review; escalation audit
Remediation: Create representative test scenarios and review disparate outcomes

Risk_Statement: Agents may not understand limitations or when to override the draft
Existing_Control_Evidence: No evidenced user notice or training
Proposed_Controls: In-product notice; limitation guidance; training; escalation path
Remediation: Document intended use prohibited use and override instructions

Risk_Statement: Investigation may be impaired if prompts outputs source references and approvals are not logged appropriately
Existing_Control_Evidence: No evidenced logging schema retention period or access model
Proposed_Controls: Minimum audit schema; retention standard; access controls; review workflow
Remediation: Define logging fields retention and authorized readers

Risk_Statement: A vendor model update or knowledge-base change could degrade quality without detection
Existing_Control_Evidence: No evidenced release gate or benchmark
Proposed_Controls: Version inventory; approval gate; regression tests; rollback plan
Remediation: Create pre-release benchmark and change approval process

Risk_Statement: Teams may lack a defined response when harmful drafts or data-handling failures occur
Existing_Control_Evidence: No evidenced AI incident classification or playbook
Proposed_Controls: AI incident playbook; kill switch; triage owner; post-incident review
Remediation: Publish tabletop-tested response procedure before pilot
